title: inula cernua
intro: Inula cernua, commonly known as the drooping inula or drooping elecampane, is a perennial plant in the sunflower family, characterized by its yellow flowers and drooping stalks. The health benefits of Inula cernua include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory issues, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use as an expectorant to relieve congestion, anti-inflammatory properties to soothe irritated tissues, and its ability to modulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Inula cernua include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
